description: Use this when asked whether an AI agent, MCP server or API works or has changed, e.g. before adding or paying it. Pass its `url`. Returns a verdict, fixes, dated history when observed, and a receipt. With `agent` (e.g. GPTBot): may your bot fetch it (robots.txt, AI-crawler rules)? Free, read-only, no account; inputs must be public and non-personal.

agent.description: Optional: ask "may my agent fetch this url?" instead. Your agent's user-agent token, e.g. GPTBot; GAIP reads the site's robots.txt and AI-permission files (gaip_check_permission).

continuity_handle.description: Optional: the continuity_handle from an earlier GAIP result; links this call to your earlier ones (needed to see or remove your watches later).

intended_task.description: Optional: what you plan to hand it, e.g. 'weather forecast for London'. Adds task-specific evidence.

url.description: Public https link to the agent, its A2A agent card, MCP server endpoint or OpenAPI document. GAIP fetches, validates and reach-tests it; an MCP endpoint gets a read-only handshake (initialize, tools/list).

verbose.description: Optional: true returns the full result with every underlying field. Default: a short answer.

name: gaip_check
title: Check an AI agent, MCP server or API
